newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PRESS DIGEST - South Africa - Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Africa - Jan 2.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the South African press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The new year was ushered in on Wednesday morning with a near-fatal bomb attack on the family-owned Sea Point home of former Hard Livings gang leader Rashied Staggie.

- Armoured police vehicles were called in to patrol the debris-littered streets of the Gauteng province's Hillbrow on New Year's night as dwellers pelted revellers with assorted items in the heat of the celebrations which claimed the lives of three people and left scores more injured.
- Two policemen were shot dead near the Zonk'iZizwe squatter camp in Katlehong in Gauteng's East Rand area on Tuesday.
-- NOTE: - Business Day was not published on Thursday. Normal publication will resume on Friday.
